description: Measured temperature history of a room with statistics (min, max, mean, variability) and coverage/gaps. Default: last 24 h, aggregated. Missing data is reported, never filled in.

from.description: Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone.

home_id.description: Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home.

mode.description: summary = statistics only; aggregated (default) = statistics + up to max_points buckets; detailed = raw values (bounded).

period.description: Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to.

room_name.description: Room name (case- and accent-insensitive). Use room_id or room_name.

scale.description: Measurement resolution. "auto" (default) picks the finest scale that fits the range.

to.description: Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given.
